PlaceOfListing.name: Place Of Listing
PlaceOfListing.definition: Place where the referenced financial instrument is listed.

DayCountBasis.name: Day Count Basis
DayCountBasis.definition: Specifies the computation method of (accrued) interest of the financial instrument.

ClassificationType.name: Classification Type
ClassificationType.definition: Classification type of the financial instrument, as per the ISO Classification of Financial Instrument (CFI).

OptionStyle.name: Option Style
OptionStyle.definition: Specifies how an option can be exercised.

DenominationCurrency.name: Denomination Currency
DenominationCurrency.definition: Currency in which a financial instrument is currently denominated.

NextCouponDate.name: Next Coupon Date
NextCouponDate.definition: Next payment date of an interest bearing financial instrument.

FloatingRateFixingDate.name: Floating Rate Fixing Date
FloatingRateFixingDate.definition: Date on which the interest rate or redemption price will be/was calculated according to the terms of the issue.

MaturityDate.name: Maturity Date
MaturityDate.definition: Date on which a financial instrument becomes due and assets are to be repaid.

IssueDate.name: Issue Date
IssueDate.definition: Date at which the security was made available.

NextCallableDate.name: Next Callable Date
NextCallableDate.definition: Date on which a financial instrument is called away/redeemed before its scheduled maturity.

PutableDate.name: Putable Date
PutableDate.definition: Date on which a holder of a financial instrument has the right to request redemption of the principal amount prior to its scheduled maturity date.

DatedDate.name: Dated Date
DatedDate.definition: Date on which an interest bearing financial instrument begins to accrue interest.

ConversionDate.name: Conversion Date
ConversionDate.definition: Deadline by which a convertible security must be converted, according to the terms of the issue.

PreviousFactor.name: Previous Factor
PreviousFactor.definition: Factor used to calculate the value of the outstanding principal of the financial instrument (for factored securities) until the next redemption (factor) date.

NextFactor.name: Next Factor
NextFactor.definition: Factor used to calculate the value of the outstanding principal of the financial instrument (for factored securities) that will applicable after the redemption (factor) date.

InterestRate.name: Interest Rate
InterestRate.definition: Annualised interest rate of a financial instrument used to calculate the actual interest rate of the coupon or the accrued interest.

NextInterestRate.name: Next Interest Rate
NextInterestRate.definition: Interest rate applicable to the next interest payment period in relation to variable rate instruments.

MinimumNominalQuantity.name: Minimum Nominal Quantity
MinimumNominalQuantity.definition: Minimum nominal quantity of financial instrument.

MinimumQuantityToInstruct.name: Minimum Quantity To Instruct
MinimumQuantityToInstruct.definition: Minimum quantity of financial instrument that may be instructed.

MinimumMultipleQuantityToInstruct.name: Minimum Multiple Quantity To Instruct
MinimumMultipleQuantityToInstruct.definition: Minimum multiple quantity of financial instrument that may be instructed.

ContractSize.name: Contract Size
ContractSize.definition: Ratio or multiplying factor used to convert one contract into a financial instrument quantity.

IssuePrice.name: Issue Price
IssuePrice.definition: Initial issue/valuation price of a resulting security under a corporate action.

BabyBondDenomination.name: Baby Bond Denomination
BabyBondDenomination.definition: Dollar amount attributed to the bond when the par value is less than 1000.

PreviousNextFactorRule.definition: In case of partial redemption by pool factor, PreviousFactor provides the factor applicable before redemption and NextFactor provides the factor applicable after redemption.

MaturityDateRule.definition: Maturity date may only provide generic information about the final maturity of the underlying instrument.
